title: Real-World Efficacy and Durability of Faricimab in Aflibercept-Resistant Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration
condition: Aflibercept-resistant neovascular AMD (persistent SRF or IRF despite at least three consecutive aflibercept injections at 4-6-week intervals), switched to faricimab; 60 eyes of 60 patients, Yeungnam University, 2023-2024, retrospective; subtypes typical nAMD 24, PCV 32, RAP 4; no previous vitreoretinal surgery or PDT

groups.description: Whole cohort; after switching, PRN with a minimum injection interval of 8 weeks and no mandatory loading doses

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA row and p-value column
exclusions.reason: Visual acuity and p-values are not extracted

exclusions.what: Table 2 subfoveal choroidal thickness and maximum PED height/width rows
exclusions.reason: Choroidal thickness and PED dimensions are out of scope

exclusions.what: Table 3 factors associated with complete resolution of SRF and IRF
exclusions.reason: Logistic regression on a post-baseline outcome (fluid resolution); not a thickness series
Duplicate of the Table 2 baseline for the same eyes; Table 2 cited

notes: Measure: central subfield thickness (CST) on Heidelberg Spectralis SD-OCT; recorded as central_subfield by the protocol's CST naming.
Prior treatment: all eyes previously treated with aflibercept (and other anti-VEGF) before the switch.
Indication namd includes PCV and RAP subtypes (subtype counts in condition).
Role control: approved agent, single real-world cohort without an investigational arm.

series.baseline_label: Baseline at the switch visit (Table 2, row 3 'Central subfield thickness', column 2)
series.notes: Mean +/- SD (Statistical Analysis); time origin is the switch to faricimab (first faricimab injection); visits at 1, 3 and 6 months after switching; per-visit n not reported (mean follow-up given in weeks in the Results)
